crew.overview: After an altercation between Alex, the president's son, and Britain's Prince Henry at a royal event becomes tabloid fodder, their long-running feud now threatens to drive a wedge in U.S./British relations. When the rivals are forced into a staged truce, their icy relationship begins to thaw and the friction between them sparks something deeper than they ever expected.
crew.title: Red, White & Royal Blue

crew.overview: 40-year-old single mom Solène begins an unexpected romance with 24-year-old Hayes Campbell, the lead singer of August Moon, the hottest boy band on the planet. As they begin a whirlwind romance, it isn't long before Hayes' superstar status poses unavoidable challenges to their relationship, and Solène soon discovers that life in the glare of his spotlight might be more than she bargained for.
crew.title: The Idea of You

details.biography: Luísa Villas-Boas is a Portuguese film director focused on developing bold ideas on a shoestring. After moving to London at the age of 18 to study filmmaking, Luísa worked for two years as a covid PA in the film industry and as a film equipment technician. They then returned to Portugal to develop their directorial work and seek a Master’s in film. Luísa’s career goal is to create films with a mission, stories that remind us of the best in humanity and push the limits of cinematic wonder.
details.name: Luísa Villas-Boas
